items.zh: 应该鼓励孩子们多参与户外活动。
items.en: Children should be encouraged to take part in more outdoor activities.

items.zh: 随着人工智能的发展，许多传统行业正面临着巨大的挑战。
items.en: With AI gaining momentum, traditional industries are facing tremendous challenges.

items.zh: 工会每个月推出惠民活动，大家只需要网上预约，就可免费体验。
items.en: The union rolls out public welfare activities on a monthly basis, which are available to try for free upon online reservation.

items.zh: 在学校的农耕课程中，学生们全程参与田间劳作，体会到了“粒粒皆辛苦“的含义。
items.en: In the school farming courses, students participate in every aspect of field work, and thus gain an understanding of the meaning behind “Every grain comes with toil”.

items.zh: 随着新学期的开始，学生们需要快速调整心态，以适应更加紧张和繁重的学习任务。
items.en: As the new term begins, students need to promptly adjust their mindset to the more intensive and demanding academic workload.
